title: A Green Test Suite Should Let You Relax. Mine Did Not.
excerpt: A green test suite should create confidence. Mine made me check the Kubernetes context one more time. Here is how I rebuilt OptiPod's test architecture.

media.alt: An unreliable shared Kubernetes test environment beside a calm, isolated test chamber.
Of 155 legacy scenarios, 6 were retained, 87 were replaced at a better test layer, and 62 were removed as duplicate, outdated, or setup-only.

The old path used the current kubeconfig, a fixed cluster, static waits, and manual cleanup. The new path uses a private kubeconfig, a unique Kind cluster, real condition checks, redacted evidence, and scoped cleanup.
Ten consecutive local smoke runs passed in 300 to 311 seconds each. The hosted smoke job took 8 minutes 51 seconds against a goal of less than 6 minutes.
